run_knn_evaluation_cli: run the DINOv2 k-NN classification evaluation on ImageNet using the command line interface
eval_knn_with_model: evaluate a DINOv2 model using k-NN classification and save results to a JSON file
eval_knn: extract train and validation features then perform k-NN classification evaluation with multiple k values
create_KnnModule: create a distributed k-NN module that computes nearest neighbors across GPU ranks for feature classification
create_module_dict: create a dictionary of k-NN modules with different per-class sampling strategies and multiple random tries
